answer: An agent economy can deter Sybil attacks through optical token attestation. Each agent must route laser challenges through a unique scattering medium of colloidal opal spheres and pigment grains mounted on a marble base to return deterministic speckle patterns. An adversary incurs the verifiable cost of fabricating unforgeable physical microstructures and running dedicated optical sensors per identity. However, thermal expansion can perturb speckle alignments, causing false rejections.
